# temps_telemetry_settings (Resource)

Whether the instance sends anonymous usage telemetry. An environment variable on the server overrides it (`source`). Destroying the resource leaves the setting as it is.

Import with `telemetry_settings`.

Required API key permissions: `settings:read`, `system:admin`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "temps_telemetry_settings" "this" {
  enabled = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `enabled` (Boolean) Send anonymous telemetry.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Import ID, `telemetry_settings`.
- `source` (String) Where the effective value comes from.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Singleton: the import ID is the resource type without the prefix.
terraform import temps_telemetry_settings.this telemetry_settings
```
